errors.what: The rendered geometry does not look like a three-planet epicyclic set. There are no visible gear discs or ring, and the planets are not equally spaced at 120 degrees. A large green triangle changes shape and size from frame to frame, which a rigid carrier with fixed planet-axle radii cannot do. The sun-ring-planet pitch geometry (Zr/Zs = 2.5) is not recognisable.

The visible arm that tracks the sun angle (about 90 degrees at t=1.00, 180 at t=2.00, 270 at t=3.00) turns at the full sun rate. The carrier is shown at only sun/3.5 (25.7 degrees at t=1.00). No visible element clearly turns at the carrier rate, so the motion on screen disagrees with the panel's carrier_deg. The fixed horizontal blue bar stays at +X while sun_deg changes.
